description: The vm-rxe-baseline tests repeated between a hostNetwork pod on each worker. The pods run the pinned RDMA test image and use the node's RXE device against the lab NIC addresses, while every NIC of both nodes is captured. This shows a container can use the node's RDMA device. It does not show a pod-private interface, device isolation or Cilium's pod data path. Bandwidth is a software measurement of this host and guest pair.

security.device_exposure: The two test pods run in the lab namespace at the PodSecurity privileged level, which hostNetwork needs. Each is pinned to its worker by the kubernetes.io/hostname label, uses the node's network, sets securityContext.privileged so the device cgroup admits /dev/infiniband, and runs as uid 65534 with no effective capability. No hostPID, no host IPC, no volume and no container runtime socket. Narrower profiles were tried and fail, and every run shows it again in narrower-profiles-fail. kubectl runs on the first control plane; tcpdump and process cleanup use sudo on the workers.
